description: The line plot illustrates the performance of two models — “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information” — as measured by their Macro-F1 Score (%) across varying numbers of tokens, ranging from approximately 0.5 to 1.5 on the x-axis. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, spans from 48% to 58%, with major gridlines at 2% intervals. The “MATTER (ours)” model is represented by a pink line with circular markers and a shaded confidence region; it begins at ~55% at 0.5 tokens, dips slightly to ~54.5% at 0.6, rises to a peak of ~58% at 1.0 tokens, then declines to ~51% at 1.5 tokens. The “w/o material information” model is shown as a purple line with circular markers and a lighter shaded region; it starts at ~52.5% at 0.5 tokens, remains relatively stable around 53–54% until 1.3 tokens, then drops sharply to ~47.5% at 1.5 tokens. Both lines exhibit fluctuations, but “MATTER (ours)” consistently outperforms the ablated version across most token counts, especially beyond 0.8 tokens, with the largest performance gap occurring near 1.5 tokens.
